## Appearance

Hester Gray is described as a small girl with soft eyes. She has dark hair that is easily ruffled by the wind.

_Sources: [v2 XXVI Around the Bend P40](../source/v02-c26.md#nw-v02-c26-p0040)_

## Personality

Hester Gray is described as a very pretty and sweet individual who lacked much skill as a housekeeper. However, she possessed a natural knack for working with flowers.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051)_

## History

Hester Gray was brought up in the country and always wanted to return to it. After working in a [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) store that she hated, she married [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) Gray, who built a small house for them on a farm in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) given to him by his father. Hester lived with [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) in the little house on the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) farm for four years before her death, leaving behind a forgotten garden that was later discovered by local girls.

_Sources: [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P1](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0001), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P2](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0002), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P4](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0004), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P5](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0005), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P8](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0008), +64 more_

## Relationships

### [Jordan](../character/jordan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/hester-gray--jordan.md)

[Jordan](../character/jordan.md) was the husband of Hester Gray, whom she married in [Boston](../codex/places.md#boston) before the couple relocated to [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea). According to the romantic tale retold by [Diana](../character/diana.md), they lived together until Hester's early death at the age of twenty-two. Their former home and her forgotten garden remain as the primary physical memory of their life together.

- Spouse of — married in Boston and moved to Avonlea  <sub>[v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P51](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0051), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P54](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0054)</sub>
